items.text: The ver. 2.0.6 update applies various changes listed below.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537978/2ae26d98295acbbf7a2d28c1cdbdfc43d68184cc.png"]

Players who have saved data for both Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising and Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok can claim the Karmic Sword of the Apocalypse tie-in bonus from the Knickknack Shack.
Each user account/profile must have saved data for both games stored on the same console or PC.
More information about Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising is available from the official website:
Fixed a bug where, while playing either the New World Order or On the Threshold of The World quests, players unintentionally took damage when The World's Celestial Sphere ability was activated.
Fixed an intermittent bug where sigils possessing trait effects that only have a single trait level (T. Lvl 15) were incorrectly obtained at T. Lvl 11 instead.
War Elemental
Untouchable
Potent Greens
Roll of the Die
Flight over Fight
Any sigils in a player's Inventory that were affected by this bug will be corrected to T. Lvl 15.
The content rating provided by ClassInd, Brazil's advisory ratings authority, has been changed from 12 to 14.
Official Website｜Updates
The ver. 2.0.5 update applies various changes listed below.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth="695"][th colwidth="695"]
Gallanza
[td colwidth="695"]
・Fixed a bug that allowed Gallanza to activate his Skybound Art without a full SBA gauge as he entered Deathmatch Finale or reached the max level of Wild Showman.
[th colwidth="695"]
Fediel
[td colwidth="695"]

・Reduced the max level of Fediel's Enhanced Combo Finishers effect granted by Insight: Finishing Touch from 10 to 5, and reduced the attack power of her magic orbs while Enhanced Combo Finishers isn't in effect.

Before these adjustments were made, Fediel was capable of dealing significant damage by repeatedly using combo finishers at the lowest level of Enhanced Combo Finishers, which disincentivized the need to raise its effect level.

To address this shortcoming without overcorrecting the playstyle, her magic orbs will now deal less damage without Enhanced Combo Finishers, but at the same time, Enhanced Combo Finishers can reach its max effect level more quickly.
Magic orbs have been adjusted to deal higher damage as the effect level increases, but damage at max level will remain roughly the same as before the adjustments.
Fixed an intermittent bug where the boss in The Not Forgotten Sky quest remained permanently out of attack range, thereby softlocking the quest.
Fixed an intermittent bug that caused the camera to stop working properly while playing either the New World Order or On the Threshold of The World quests in online co-op.

Fixed an intermittent bug where, while playing either the New World Order or On the Threshold of The World quests, the camera stopped working properly after The World activated its Celestial Sphere ability.

Fixed an intermittent bug where, while playing either the Let Chaos Reign or On the Threshold of Chaos quests, the camera stopped working properly after Beelzebub activated his Hail to the King ability.

Fixed a bug that erroneously reduced the quantity of limited-supply Conflux treasure bundles to 0. This occurred when the player viewed the bundles before starting a survey, and then retreated from that survey without earning a single boon.
To remedy the situation, the stock of treasure bundles will be reset as follows:
[table equalcells="1" colwidth="372,"][th colwidth="372"]
Condition
Resolution
[td colwidth="372"]
Player doesn't own any Chaos Refinium or Mythic Artifacts, and hasn't forged their applicable weapons.
All bundles will be reset
[td colwidth="372"]
Player doesn't own any Chaos Refinium and hasn't forged their applicable weapons.
Bundles other than Forger's Bounty (Stinger) will be reset
[td colwidth="372"]
Player doesn't own any Mythic Artifacts and hasn't forged their applicable weapons.
Bundles other than Forger's Bounty (Terminus) will be reset
[td colwidth="372"]
If none of the above conditions apply
Bundles other than Forger's Bounty (Stinger) and Forger's Bounty (Terminus) will be reset

Note: If a player already owns Chaos Refinium or Mythic Artifacts, the treasure bundles containing those items won't be reset. This is to prevent saddling players with redundant Chaos Refinium or Mythic Artifacts, which can't be sold or removed from Inventory.
Fixed a rare bug that caused a discrepancy between the number of rescued wee pincers in a player's Key Items and the number of rescued wee pincers according to Chapter Select.
Wee pincers that are missing due to this bug will be added back to the player's Inventory upon interacting with Sierokarte at the Knickknack Shack.
Fixed a bug that caused the requirements for unlocking the Demon King trophy to apply to all areas of the survey instead of to the Beelzebub Conflux battle only.
Fixed two bugs that prevented players from obtaining the My Evil Eye Approves! trophy:

Claiming the Enchantress's Blessing sigil included in the Character Expansion Set: Fraux DLC, or claiming The Black's Mark sigil included in the Character Expansion Set: Fediel DLC from the Knickknack Shack.
Unlocking the My Evil Eye Approves! trophy for one save slot erroneously fulfilled the trophy requirement for other save slots.
Fixed an intermittent bug where navigating between menus in a certain manner allowed the player to equip master traits beyond the equip limit.

The ver. 2.0.4 update applies various changes listed below.
Fixed a bug that prevented Fatebreaker-grade players from loading their saved data if they saved while on the Grandcypher's deck.
If you've already saved on the Grandcypher's deck, installing this update will allow you to load your saved data.
Official Website｜Updates
The following updates apply the various changes listed below.
Fixed an intermittent bug where the network connection would hang while attempting to fetch the backup list.
Fixed a bug where, if another player's captain had a character-unique sigil equipped and was set to the opposite appearance of your own captain, that captain wouldn't appear in the backup list.
Fixed an intermittent bug where, while playing online co-op, the game would become softlocked after repeating and clearing quests aboard the Grandcypher's deck and then traveling to Seedhollow.
Fixed a bug where, if matchmaking had timed out and the party leader became disconnected while the "Retry" pop-up was displayed, the game would become softlocked for the remaining party members.
Fixed a bug where, after linking with Cygames ID, attempting to claim link bonuses from the Knickknack Shack while playing co-op caused the game to crash.
Improved the performance of network functionality, thereby reducing occurrences of network errors.
Applies to the Steam platform.
Fixed an intermittent bug where a non-player-controlled Sandalphon using Talviyö wouldn't join a link attack.
Fixed an intermittent bug that caused The Not Forgotten Sky quest to softlock when the following foe abilities were executed under specific conditions:
Vermillion Claw / Vivid Fire
Azure Eddy / Fatal Attractor
Gold Rockfall / Universal Paroxysm
Emerald Beak / Exhaustive Collapse
White Flare / Myribolt Refraction
Black Hex / Necrotic Storm
The English voice line for Lucilius's Final Rebellion has now been properly implemented.
Fixed a bug where, while playing online co-op and Quest Cutscene Auto-Skip was enabled, boss defeat cutscenes were skipped even for first-time clears.
Unique voice lines that play after clearing a quest for the first time will now play every time that quest is cleared. This change applies to the following quests:

Make sure you've watched the cutscene "New Allies," and then travel to Folca or Seedhollow to receive the missing crewmate cards.
Fixed a bug where attempting to convert saved data for ver. 1.2.2 or lower caused the game to crash.
Fixed an intermittent bug where the following trophies wouldn't unlock properly:

Fixed an intermittent bug where HP, ATK, and M. Lvl wouldn't display properly when playing co-op with three or more players.
Fixed an intermittent bug where quickly and repeatedly switching to and from the Weapon Collection Bonus screen caused the game to crash.
The "Show Once a Day, Then Skip" option under Quest Cutscene Auto-Skip now displays the correct text in Korean.
Other bug fixes.
Bugs that are currently under investigation, as well as newly discovered bugs, will be assessed for future updates.

The ver. 1.3.2 update applies various changes listed below. Players who have purchased the disc version are strongly encouraged to download and install this latest update.
Increased the damage cap for Sandalphon's Skybound Art, Paradise Lost.
Updated the skill description text for Sandalphon's Talviyö.
Lowered the health and attack power of bosses that appear in "Pageant of Might and Magic" and "Zathba's 'Volunteers'."
Changed the time limit of "Pageant of Might and Magic" and "Zathba's 'Volunteers'" to 20 minutes.
Changed the time limit of "Dark Swordsman's Nightmare" to 30 minutes.
Fixed a bug that caused the screen to not display properly after skipping a cutscene during "The Final Vision."
[Photo Mode] Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, character facial expressions wouldn't display properly.
[Photo Mode] Fixed a bug that caused certain parts of Lucilius's character model to become visually distorted.
[Misc.] Various bug fixes.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience these issues may have caused.
The following updates apply the various changes listed below. Players who have purchased the disc version are strongly encouraged to download and install this latest update.
Added four new quests: "Pageant of Might and Magic," "Zathba's 'Volunteers,'" "Dark Swordsman's Nightmare," and "Zero.": Clear the quest "The Final Vision" to unlock the aforementioned new quests.

Added a new playable character: Sandalphon. This character requires a special crewmate card, which can be traded for at the Knickknack Shack. Treasure required for the card is obtained from the quests "The Final Vision" or "Zero.": *A Character Expansion Set is also available for purchase. This set contains the necessary treasure for unlocking Sandalphon.
Added sigils with new traits. They will appear in the Knickknack Shack after unlocking Extreme-difficulty quests.
Added new trophies.
Added new side quests: "How Does Siero Do It?," "Astral Research Notes," and "Be Legendary." They will appear in Folca after clearing Chapter Ø Skybound Heart.

Added the Sigil Synthesis feature to the Knickknack Shack. Legendary (+) mark sigils can now be combined to create a sigil with inherited traits. Sigil Synthesis becomes available after unlocking Proud-difficulty quests.
Added Photo Mode. This feature becomes available after reaching Folca during Chapter 1 of the main story.
Added a map overlay. This feature becomes available upon reaching Sundappled Grove during the Prologue of the main story.
Added a new category to Game Options: Control Scheme. This setting adds 3 types of button configurations for town and battle controls.
Added an option on the Title Screen to rewatch the end credits. This option becomes available after clearing the Final Chapter.
Added the ability to lock acquired sigils and wrightstones directly from town services and results screens.
Added the ability to directly check trait details from the details screen of weapons, sigils, and wrightstones.
Added the ability to claim all unlocked trophy rewards at once from the Trophies screen in Lyria's Journal.

Combo skip effects gained right after link attacks and damage skills should now be retained after dodging.

The following update applies various changes listed below. Players who have purchased the disc version are strongly encouraged to download and install this latest update.

Added two new challenging quests: "Gulp... So These Are the Rumored Monsters" and "Lock Horns.": How to unlock "Gulp... So These Are the Rumored Monsters": Unlock Extreme-difficulty quests.: How to unlock "Lock Horns": Clear "The Tale of Bahamut's Rage" quest.
